lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.contract: App private flag starts bounded local sink; every SQLite/line token reports phases/counts independently of legacy observation slots. App owns MediaStore writer/memory sampler and stock MapLibre13.7.1 frame callbacks. External owned tooling binds APK/session/PID/start_ticks and separates process memory, SDK resources, allocation samples and CPU windows. Existing SQLite/NGW/Collector producers, originals, styles, saved-state and public defaults remain unchanged. No long-term-cache optimization or per-layer native ownership claim.
